sentences.en: In a big house lived many mice.
In the house lived also a quiet cat.

sentences.ar: הוא הלך בלי קול על הרצפה.
sentences.en: He walked without sound on the floor.
The mice did not hear him at all.
Every week another mouse disappeared.

sentences.ar: יום אחד הם עשו אספה בחור.
sentences.en: One day they held a meeting in the hole.
The oldest among them said: what shall we do?
One said: we shall go out only at night.

sentences.ar: אחר אמר: גם בלילה הוא ער.
sentences.en: Another said: at night too he is awake.
Everyone spoke and did not find a solution.
And then a young, clever mouse got up.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: יש לי רעיון פשוט.
sentences.en: He said: I have a simple idea.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: נשים פעמון על הצוואר שלו.
sentences.en: He said: we shall put a bell on his neck.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ואז נשמע אותו מרחוק.
sentences.en: He said: and then we shall hear him from far away.
All the mice shouted: an excellent idea.
They rejoiced and talked a long time.
And then the oldest mouse got up.
He said: the idea is really fine.

sentences.ar: הוא שאל: ומי ישים את הפעמון?
sentences.en: He asked: and who will put the bell on?

sentences.ar: אף אחד לא ענה לו כלום.
sentences.en: No one answered him anything.
It is easy to say, and hard to do.
